# mtncloud_tenant (Data Source)

The tenant the provider is logged in to: its ID and name. Everything this provider makes is made in this tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The tenant this login belongs to.
data "mtncloud_tenant" "me" {}

output "tenant" {
  value = {
    id   = data.mtncloud_tenant.me.id
    name = data.mtncloud_tenant.me.name
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The tenant's ID.
- `master` (Boolean) Whether this is the master tenant.
- `name` (String) The tenant's name. Projects are named `<project>-<name>`.
